source.title: Nonlinear matrix equations in applied probability - Solution techniques and open problems

trace.notes: Normalized the input as a single zbMATH resolver URL for document id 4046966.

Queried the zbMATH REST document API for id 4046966. The resolver metadata identified the work as V. Ramaswami, Nonlinear matrix equations in applied probability - Solution techniques and open problems, SIAM Review 30(2), 256-263 (1988), with DOI 10.1137/1030046. The zbMATH editorial content was unavailable due to conflicting licenses, so the page/API record was treated as metadata only.

Followed DOI and publisher candidates. The SIAM landing page exposed title, abstract, references, purchase text, and a View PDF option, but not the full article body containing the open-problem statements. Local PDF retrieval from the SIAM PDF endpoint was blocked by a Cloudflare challenge. Crossref exposed the same SIAM PDF candidate, while OpenAlex reported open_access.is_oa=false, oa_status=closed, and any_repository_has_fulltext=false.
failure_mode=paywalled_or_restricted. The exact work could be identified, but no readable PDF or HTML full-text artifact for the same work was recovered.

trace.notes: Ran bounded exact-work recovery using exact title plus PDF, exact DOI plus PDF, and exact title plus author/search terms. Inspected candidates included the SIAM landing page/table of contents, Wikidata, ResearchGate listing snippets, the zbMATH author profile, and related citing articles. They were rejected because they were metadata-only, snippets/abstract listings, or different works rather than a readable artifact for this exact article.
